audit: audit_return gains a recovery profile: 165 expected identities for the five libraries, 1000/150 MiB/900 s bounds, empty_206 status, allow-listed headers only, index waits at least 15 s and 45 s apart in the log unless the run stopped on a bound, receipt pins incl. contract and parent results sha

bounds.network: ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov over https, byte ranges only, no redirects

cause_of_original_failure: UNKNOWN. The schedule below is an experimental transport repair, not a proven cure.
completion: recovery run status is computed over its own 165 expected identities exactly as in amendment 1 (complete only if all 165 present and usable)
frozen_before: implementing the recovery code, the merger, or any endpoint read; authorises exactly ONE missing-only recovery run
not_claimed: recovery success does not validate the counts as measurements of regulatory function, and a failed recovery is reported as such
one_recovery_only: no second recovery under this contract; remaining unusable identities are persisted in the union receipt as unresolved

parent.immutable: the parent partial_data result and its 165 usable rows are never edited, re-read or replaced

scope.expected_from: controls.json windows x these 5 libraries; must equal the parent's 165 unusable identities exactly (checked by the merger)
scope.not_read: the 5 usable parent libraries 2dpa2, 4dpa1, 4dpa2, 6dpa1, 6dpa2 are not contacted
scope.unchanged: protocol.json (sha256 7a2ec7be…) windows, count rule, summary rule and transport_amendment 1 and 2; no threshold or window change; file sizes and URLs from controls.json unchanged

transport.after_index_failure: if the index fails on attempt 3 the library's 33 identities are recorded library_unavailable, no window request is made for it, and no further retry occurs in this run or in any automatic follow-up
transport.clock: all timing logic takes an injected clock and sleep; tests never sleep for real and generate no load
transport.empty_206: HTTP 206 with a matching Content-Range and zero body bytes is classified empty_206 (not short_read); any other short body stays short_read
transport.headers_never_logged: every other header, including Authorization, Cookie, Set-Cookie and any X- header; values are recorded verbatim for the allow-listed names only

index_schedule.rule: the wait is taken only after a failed attempt and only if the runtime bound would not be passed by waiting; otherwise the run ends stopped_on_bound; each attempt is logged and charged as before (reservation expected+1)

transport.window_attempts: unchanged from amendment 1: at most 2 attempts, no wait

union.inputs: parent science/ directory and the recovery science/ directory
union.lineage: every union row is the source row unchanged plus run ('v1' or 'recovery-v1'), source_results_sha256 and source_row_index; the sources are never modified
union.receipt: union_receipt.json pins parent results sha, recovery results sha, contract sha and the union sha256
refuse: parent results sha256 differing from the pin above
parent or recovery receipt hash mismatch
recovery run pins (protocol, amendments 1-3, this contract, parent results sha) differing from the pinned values
any identity present in both runs
recovery identities differing from the parent's unusable identities
missing or extra identity in the union
any row whose content differs from the source row it claims
promotion: a union status of complete while any identity is missing or unusable
union.status: complete only if 330 identities present and all usable; otherwise partial_data, with unresolved identities listed; counts from the two runs are never merged, averaged, rescaled or imputed
union.summary: recomputed over the union with the frozen summary rule; a library's windows and its comparison windows always come from the same run
